project_type: Electron desktop app (.sct) with a Node SDK (packages/env) and a SpacetimeDB relay module (packages/relay)
build_system: Bun 1.4.4 scripts in root package.json, electron-vite
test_framework: bun test in tests/ (no new tests without user approval)
build_command: bun run build:sdk && bun run build:vscode
test_command: bun run check && bun run typecheck:tsc
verification_instructions: From repo root: bun run check, bun run typecheck:tsc, bun run build:sdk. Never run tsc directly.
snapshot_or_generated_files: packages/env/dist is generated by build:sdk and ignored by git. A packages/vscode/dist folder is ignored by the **/dist/** eslint rule and the dist/ gitignore entry.
environment_constraints: Windows host, shared checkout with many uncommitted edits by others. Do not commit. Do not edit AGENTS.md or decision tables.
contribution_requirements: No any. Inline single-use values. Main function shows the success path, helpers below. ASD-STE100 for docs and reports. Ask the user before assumptions.
key_patterns: packages/env/src/index.ts holds a private sctExecutable() (SCT_CLI env, then on win32 %LOCALAPPDATA%/Programs/sct/bin/sct.json, else 'sct'). packages/env/tsconfig.json has rootDir ./src and emits declarations, so a shared module must live under packages/env/src or the SDK build breaks with TS6059. The app CLI (src/main/index.ts) accepts only run, _env, agent, mcp, skills. Any other argument opens the desktop window. No --version command exists.
directory_structure: src/main (Electron main and CLI), src/renderer, src/shared, packages/env (SDK), packages/relay (relay module), scripts/, tests/, docs/
